text: The Transportation Working Group, Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee would like to request that the Committee be provided with an update on accessibility during construction of the Eglinton Crosstown Light Rail Transit located on Eglinton Avenue.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee recommends to the Executive Committee that: 1. The General Manager, Transportation Services be requested to: a. Invite representatives from Metrolinx to provide an update to the Committee on the construction of the Eglinton Crosstown Light Rail Transit. b. Request representatives from the TTC to provide an update to the Committee on the construction of the Eglinton Crosstown Light Rail Transit.
